shellCommands.command: ls && cat package.json && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ && ls src 2>/dev/null; ls app 2>/dev/null
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -20; echo "tsc exit: $?"

(npx next dev -p 3123 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ && break; done; echo "--- / ---"; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ | grep -i "x-request-id\|HTTP/"; echo "--- /some/other/path ---"; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/some/other/path | grep -i "x-request-id\|HTTP/"; echo "--- server log ---"; cat /tmp/next-dev.log; pkill -f "next dev -p 3123" || true
git status --short && git diff tsconfig.json && git diff --no-index /dev/null AGENTS.md | head -30
git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts && git status --short
